hook: Company kitni salary [[baant]] rahi hai? SUM aur AVG se poochho

slides.title: SUM = [[total]], AVG = [[average]]
slides.note: Jaise party ka bill: SUM = **total**, AVG = **per head** 🍕

slides.title: Aaj ka [[data]]
slides.note: Dev ki salary abhi **decide nahi** hui, isliye NULL 👀

slides.title: Ek query, [[do answer]]
slides.code:
SELECT
  SUM(salary) AS total,
  AVG(salary) AS average
FROM employees;

slides.title: Result [[dekho]]
slides.note: AVG = 2,80,000 ÷ **4**, 5 nahi! NULL wali row **gini hi nahi** gayi

slides.title: Sirf [[numbers]] pe chalte
slides.note: SQL Server: INT ka AVG **integer** aata. Fix: **AVG(salary * 1.0)**

slides.title: NULL = 0 [[chahiye]]?
slides.code:
SELECT
  AVG(COALESCE(salary, 0))
    AS avg_with_zero
FROM employees;
slides.note: COALESCE NULL ko **0** bana deta. Ab 2,80,000 ÷ 5 = **56,000**

slides.wrong: AVG mein NULL ko **0** maan lena (÷5)
